text: Sorry this is going to be a long one, I've been up most of the night and I'm not thinking straight. I'm looking after my nephew Kai, he's 7 months old, while my sister is away working. He's had runny poos since yesterday morning, a few of them, quite watery. He's been drinking his bottles well all day and his nappies were wet like normal yesterday, but I've just realised his nappy has been dry since this afternoon. I've changed him twice and nothing, so that's at least 12 hours now with no wee. His temperature was 38.7 when I checked about ten minutes ago. The other thing that's worrying me is he's just not himself. He's really floppy when I pick him up, like he's heavy and loose, and it's hard to get him to wake up properly. I've been talking to him and tickling his feet and he barely opens his eyes and doesn't look at me the way he normally does. Normally he's wriggling everywhere. I don't know if I'm just shattered and overthinking it but it doesn't feel right. I can't get hold of my sister. Please can someone tell me what to do.
